quest.title: By Thy Pale Beams I Solitary Rove
quest.description: Kujirai Momiji seems to have found some useful resources. Rendezvous with her, pronto...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Look, guys! I flipped through my father's sailing log again.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: There's an appendix in there that mentions a special fish bait formula they had developed.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: When they encountered the "Lunar Leviathan," they used a special bait that mixed Seagrass and Magical Crystal Ore.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: If we can also make this, we may be able to attract the "Lunar Leviathan."

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I have a lot of Seagrass, but the Magical Crystal Ore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I have them.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Eh? Really? Were they mined at Araumi?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: My father's log mentioned that the Magical Crystal Ore must be mined from the ruins at Araumi.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Although I'm not sure what the difference is, compared to ordinary Magical Crystal Ore, but since we have decided to do so, we should be more rigorous and follow the sailing log closely.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, there are a lot of dangerous monsters over at Araumi. Let's go to the Adventurers' Guild and put up a commission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay, I'll handle them.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Ah... Right, I forgot you are a powerful adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I'm so lucky to have your help, I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I'll go back and get some bait-making tools, let's meet up later at the beach on the west of Araumi.

talks.objective: Go to Araumi and look for the Special Magical Crystal Ore

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: You found them so quickly? You're a powerful adventurer indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will these be enough?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Well, watch me next, I just have to do this...this...and this...

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: This should be it, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The next step is to scatter the bait and wait for the "Lunar Leviathan" to appear, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Yes, I purposely chose this place, from where we reached the shore back then.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: The "Lunar Leviathan" that guided us back to the ship also disappeared here.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: So, is everyone ready? Don't forget to make a wish when you see the "Lunar Leviathan."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if it doesn't work?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Don't say such discouraging things, it will work. The "Lunar Leviathan" will definitely come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! It will work! Big fish, big fish, you must be good and bite the bait! I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Look! Look at this! It's glowing under the water! Something's coming!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Is the "Lunar Leviathan" really here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Help, it's a Ruin Guard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is it this guy!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: How...how did this happen, even my father's bait formula didn't work?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't be sad, it's that Ruin Guard's fault! It must have scared the "Lunar Leviathan" away! Let's try again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's try again.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Let's forget it for now, I'm a little tired. Maybe Nantuck is right?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: *sigh* I want to go and take a stroll outside. I have to think about what happens after this.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Whatever the case, thank you very much for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Ms. Kujirai wants to be left alone now, let's come back to see her later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's quite tragic that we have to snatch these from Hilichurls (Delete)
